entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, VeloFit agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to return something. I bought a pair of your cycling shoes, and I'm just so disappointed.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a fit and comfort preference?

It's the fit. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I saved up for these. I took them on one short ride and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. I just can't wear them. I really needed this to work out... and I really need that money back for some other bills.

I completely understand, and getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our riders. Let me just pull up your order. I see you received the shoes just 8 days ago. That's no problem at all.
So I can get a refund? I was so worried because I already attached the cleats to them. I feel awful about it, but they're just too painful.

Absolutely. Our cycling shoes come with a 10-day return policy, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe for a full refund. It's perfectly fine that you attached the cleats; we expect customers to try them out. As long as they're just lightly used from that one ride, we can process the return.
Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so stressed about this.

You're very welcome. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label. Just pack the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any post office. Once we receive them, we'll process your full refund.
That's wonderful. You've made my day. I really appreciate your help.
It's my pleasure. The email should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
